tx: Voldemort strikes at Godric's Hollow. Lily and James die protecting their son. The killing curse rebounds on the baby, leaving a lightning scar, and the Dark Lord loses his body.
Dumbledore, McGonagall and Hagrid leave baby Harry with his aunt and uncle at Privet Drive. He grows up unloved, never told he is a wizard.
On the eve of his eleventh birthday, hundreds of Hogwarts letters flood the house. Hagrid breaks down the door of a remote hut with the news: Harry is a wizard.
Harry gets his wand, a holly one with a phoenix-feather core, and boards the Hogwarts Express where he meets Ron Weasley and Hermione Granger.
The Sorting Hat places Harry in Gryffindor. A rivalry begins with Draco Malfoy, and Professor Snape seems to dislike Harry at once.
Ron and Harry rescue Hermione from a mountain troll in the dungeons. From that night, the three are inseparable friends.
Harry finds the Mirror of Erised, which shows what the heart most desires. The trio learn a three-headed dog guards the Philosopher's Stone, made by Nicolas Flamel.

Harry, Ron and Hermione pass Devil's Snare, flying keys, a giant chess game and a potion puzzle. Harry meets Professor Quirrell, with Voldemort hidden beneath his turban, and wins the Stone through the mirror.
A house-elf named Dobby warns Harry not to return to Hogwarts. The Dursleys lock him in, until Fred, George and Ron rescue him in a flying car.
The barrier at Platform 9¾ will not open, so Harry and Ron fly the enchanted car to school and crash into the Whomping Willow.
A message on the wall announces the Chamber of Secrets is open. Students are found petrified, and Harry hears a voice no one else can hear: he can speak Parseltongue.
Hermione brews Polyjuice Potion so the trio can question Draco Malfoy disguised as his friends. He turns out to know nothing.
Harry finds a diary belonging to one Tom Riddle. Through it he sees a memory pointing at Hagrid, and does not yet understand who Riddle really is.
Following spiders into the Forbidden Forest, Harry and Ron meet Aragog. Hermione, petrified, leaves a clue in her hand: the monster is a basilisk travelling through the pipes.
Ginny is taken into the Chamber. Harry faces Riddle's memory and a basilisk, with help from the phoenix Fawkes and a sword. He destroys the diary with a basilisk fang and saves Ginny.
Harry tricks Lucius Malfoy into handing a sock to Dobby, which frees him. Hogwarts celebrates as the petrified students wake.
After inflating his aunt in anger, Harry runs away and is carried by the Knight Bus to the Leaky Cauldron. The Ministry warns that Sirius Black has escaped Azkaban and is hunting him.
Dementors search the Hogwarts Express and Harry collapses. Professor Lupin drives them off, and later teaches Harry to cast a Patronus.
Fred and George give Harry a magical map of Hogwarts and its secret passages. It was made by four school friends who called themselves Moony, Wormtail, Padfoot and Prongs.
Draco is scratched by Buckbeak and Hagrid's hippogriff is sentenced to death. Hermione is also using a secret device to take extra classes.
Sirius drags Ron into the Willow tunnel. In the old house, the truth comes out: Sirius is innocent, Scabbers is Peter Pettigrew in disguise, and Lupin is a werewolf.
Pettigrew was the secret-keeper who betrayed Harry's parents. When the full moon rises Lupin transforms, and Pettigrew escapes.
Dementors close in on Harry and Sirius. A silver stag Patronus drives them away, and Harry realises it was himself, from the future.
Dumbledore hints that Harry and Hermione can use her Time-Turner to change the night. They free Buckbeak and Sirius, who flies away on the hippogriff.
The Weasleys and Harry watch the World Cup final. Afterward, masked wizards attack campers and a Dark Mark glows in the sky above the forest.
Beauxbatons and Durmstrang arrive for the Triwizard Tournament. Hogwarts picks Cedric Diggory, but the Goblet also names Harry Potter as a fourth champion.
The first task is to steal a golden egg from a dragon. Harry summons his broom and escapes the Hungarian Horntail.
Ron and Harry fall out over the Yule Ball. Hermione dances with Viktor Krum, and Harry learns the golden egg's secret in the prefects' bath.
In the second task, Harry rescues Gabrielle Delacour as well as his friend Ron, whatever the rules say about time. The judges reward his loyalty.
Harry and Cedric reach the cup together. It is a Portkey that takes them to a graveyard. Pettigrew kills Cedric, and Voldemort is reborn using Harry's blood.
Harry's and Voldemort's wands share a core and lock together. Echoes of those Voldemort killed emerge, including Harry's parents, giving Harry time to escape.

The teacher Alastor Moody turns out to be Barty Crouch Jr. in disguise, who put Harry in the tournament. Dumbledore tells the school that Voldemort has returned, though the Ministry refuses to believe it.
Dementors attack Harry and Dudley. Harry uses a Patronus in front of a Muggle and is called to a Ministry hearing, while the Order of the Phoenix gathers at Grimmauld Place.
The Ministry and the Daily Prophet paint Harry and Dumbledore as liars. Dolores Umbridge is sent to Hogwarts, teaching Defence and passing more and more decrees.
Hermione persuades Harry to teach students real defence in secret. They meet in the Room of Requirement and name themselves Dumbledore's Army.
Harry keeps dreaming through Voldemort's eyes, and sees Nagini attack Arthur Weasley. Snape tries to teach Harry Occlumency, with little success.
When Umbridge discovers the D.A., Dumbledore escapes arrest. Umbridge becomes Headmistress, and Fred and George leave school in a blaze of fireworks.
Tricked by a false vision of Sirius in danger, Harry and friends fly to the Ministry. Death Eaters wait for a prophecy orb, and the Order arrives to fight.
Bellatrix's curse sends Sirius through the veil. Voldemort appears in the Ministry atrium, and Dumbledore duels him while Fudge finally sees him.
Narcissa and Bellatrix visit Snape. He makes an Unbreakable Vow to protect Draco and, if need be, to finish a task Draco was given.
Harry finds an old Potions book marked by the Half-Blood Prince and starts to excel in class. Professor Slughorn is delighted and gives him a vial of Felix Felicis.
In Dumbledore's Pensieve, Harry sees Voldemort's past: his parents, the orphanage and a memory altered by Slughorn. Dumbledore explains Horcruxes, fragments of a split soul.
Draco has been repairing a Vanishing Cabinet. Katie Bell is cursed through a necklace, and Ron is poisoned by mistake. Harry suspects Draco.
Ron dates Lavender, Hermione is hurt, and Harry and Ginny finally get together after a Quidditch victory.
Dumbledore and Harry journey to a sea cave to find a Horcrux. Dumbledore drinks a draining potion, and they escape the Inferi. The locket is a fake.
Death Eaters storm Hogwarts. Draco lowers his wand, but Snape kills Dumbledore. Harry chases, and Snape reveals he is the Half-Blood Prince.
The wizarding world mourns Dumbledore. Harry ends things with Ginny to protect her and resolves to hunt Voldemort's remaining Horcruxes, with Ron and Hermione at his side.
Harry leaves Privet Drive in a convoy of decoys, each looking like him. Death Eaters attack, Hedwig and Moody are killed, and Harry reaches the Burrow.
Bill and Fleur's wedding ends with news that the Ministry has fallen. The trio disapparate to London and go into hiding at Grimmauld Place.
The trio work to find Horcruxes. They learn of the Hallows, visit Godric's Hollow where Nagini ambushes Harry, and find Gryffindor's sword in a frozen pool. Ron destroys the locket.
Captured by snatchers, the trio are taken to the Malfoys. Bellatrix tortures Hermione. Dobby apparates in to rescue them and is killed.
With Griphook's help, the trio break into Bellatrix's vault at Gringotts, steal the cup, and escape on a dragon.
Hogwarts rises: teachers, students and the Order defend the castle. Fred, Lupin and Tonks fall, and Voldemort demands that Harry surrender.
Harry learns from Snape's memories that he must die. He walks into the Forest, uses the Resurrection Stone and offers himself to Voldemort.

t: King's Cross and the last duel
tx: Harry wakes in a bright place and speaks with Dumbledore, then returns. Molly kills Bellatrix, Neville kills Nagini, and Voldemort's own curse rebounds.
On Platform 9¾, Harry and Ginny send Albus Severus off to Hogwarts, along with Rose and Scorpius. All is well.
